title: Action for the mapping machine
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, with $k$ work tapes, and let $Q_M$ be its state set. Given an input-head movement, two work-tape instructions, an optional output bit, and an optional successor state of the mapping machine whose states encode parsing, copying, returning, output, separation, or a state of $M$, the associated action has $1+(1+k)$ work tapes. It applies the first instruction to the first tape, the second instruction to the next tape, and leaves the remaining $k$ tapes unchanged; its input-head movement, output, and successor state are the supplied ones.
